chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hafs from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"He performs the prayer in which he regained consciousness."

key_terms.فِيهَا: in it (referring to the prayer time)

ai.seo_question: How many make-up prayers are required if one sleeps through multiple prayer times?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this concise ruling from Imam al-Sadi’ (AS) within the chapter of the *Mudtir* (one compelled by necessity, such as sleep or unconsciousness). It establishes the principle that a single make-up prayer suffices for the entire duration of the lapse, reflecting the juristic view that the obligation is tied to the state of neglect rather than each individual clock time. This hadith serves as a foundational text for the Shia legal methodology regarding the consolidation of missed prayers due to valid excuses.
